title: Tower Relay

scenario.intro: The relay desk handles {{thing}}s for pilots across the city. It needs the right lanes and the right answers, including for visitors with no pilot badge and pilots who aren't allowed.
scenario.goal: Set the three methods and six status codes so every request gets the truth.

objective: Right lane, right answer: for pilots, strangers, and anyone who isn't allowed.
rules: Tracking a {{thing}} reads it; sending creates one; cancelling removes it.
Found answers 2xx with data; created answers the code for "new thing"; a {{thing}} that doesn't exist answers 404.
Sending without a `to` address: valid JSON, but the data breaks the rules.
No `X-Pilot` header: we don't know who you are. A pilot who isn't a {{rank}} trying to cancel: we know, and the answer is no.
reference_solution:
READ = "GET"
SEND = "POST"
CANCEL = "DELETE"
FOUND = 200
CREATED = 201
MISSING = 404
BAD_DATA = 422
NOT_LOGGED_IN = 401
NOT_ALLOWED = 403

hints.text: Two codes are about the visitor: one means "who are you?", the other "I know you, and no".
Valid JSON that breaks the rules is 422, not 400. Sending needs the method that creates things.

dialogue.start: Relay desk is open. Every pilot, stranger and cadet gets a true answer.
dialogue.success: Relay holds! Every request got the right lane and the right code.
dialogue.fail: Some answers were wrong. Think about who is asking and what they wanted.
